Experience the latest update on Odisha’s first 6-lane twin tunnel, a 3.4 km engineering marvel under construction near Sunki Ghat, Koraput, as part of the ₹16,000 crore Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor (NH-130CD & NH-63).
This project aims to provide a smooth, safe, & fast travel route through the Eastern Ghats by bypassing sharp curves & steep ghat roads.
In this video, you’ll see:
South & North portal progress updates
Full interior visuals with lighting & safety systems
Drone footage & timeline details
Impact on travel time and regional connectivity
